name: Netcare Limited
summary: Netcare Limited, an investment holding company, operates private hospitals in South Africa. It operates through Hospital and Emergency Services, and Primary Care segments. The Hospital and Emergency Services segment engages in the hospital and pharmacy operations. Its operations covers its private acute hospital network and day clinics; and non-acute services, including emergency medical services, mental health clinics operation, diagnostics support services, and cancer care services, as well as sells healthcare products.
